name: MAMA-MIA
read_locations: Read README, nnUNet subtree, download and checkpoint instructions; identify channels, transforms and mask meaning
adopt_or_adapt: Use compatible vetted model inference or verified reference masks
avoid: Do not assume checkpoint availability, licensing or external validity
required_test: Run one approved image, compare mask/physical measurements, record resource usage

name: nnU-Net v2
read_locations: Read dataset format, nnUNetv2_predict workflow, inference pre/postprocessing and tests
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt supported nnU-Net v2 inference API in isolated worker
avoid: Do not copy training engine or mix incompatible checkpoints
required_test: Bad-channel, missing-weight, source-affine and prediction tests

name: 3D Slicer
role: medical image geometry and reference viewing
read_locations: Inspect MRML, Segmentations, Segment Editor, transformations, model/segment statistics
adopt_or_adapt: Use as independent geometry reference; leverage VTK/SimpleITK libraries
avoid: Do not transplant desktop application to web
required_test: Compare exported mesh dimensions and mask-derived volume

name: OHIF Viewer
role: web DICOM viewing and lesion tracking
adopt_or_adapt: Prototype OHIF integration versus Cornerstone3D standalone
avoid: Do not assume original longitudinal mode understands synthetic branching
required_test: Browser MRI overlay, state switch, correct patient/time, performance

name: MONAI
read_locations: Inspect transforms, MetaTensor/affine behavior, data readers, metrics and tutorials
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt supported transformations and segmentation metrics
avoid: Do not use unrelated organ models as breast segmentation
required_test: Image-mask transforms, invertibility, geometry unit tests

name: SimpleITK
role: medical image registration and spatial transforms
read_locations: Inspect ImageRegistrationMethod, Resample, direction/origin/spacing and examples
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt supported registration/resampling and save transforms
avoid: Do not assume registration always valid or comparability equal overlay
required_test: Known rigid transform, LPS/RAS roundtrip, failure QC

name: IDC Index
read_locations: Inspect IDCClient metadata hierarchy, SQL querying, download manifests
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt maintained package to download authorized selected studies
avoid: Do not bulk-download entire datasets or assume every cohort is in IDC
required_test: Download one approved series, SHA-256 and patient/study linkage

name: dcmqi
read_locations: Inspect itkimage2segimage, segimage2itkimage, tid1500writer, metadata schemas
adopt_or_adapt: Use standard converter CLI and metadata handling when required
avoid: Do not implement homemade DICOM SEG encoder

name: MONAI Label
read_locations: Inspect sample-apps/radiology, task abstractions, clients and infer adapters
adopt_or_adapt: Use annotation service pattern only when justified
avoid: Do not pull in entire annotation server for an inference call
required_test: Controlled example and exported mask alignment

name: Stan
read_locations: Inspect example models, diagnostics and posterior predictive workflows
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt mathematical diagnostics methodology; runtime integration optional
avoid: Do not label statistical checks as clinical validation
required_test: Seed reproducibility and simulated vs observed distribution checks

name: SlicerRT
read_locations: Inspect segment comparison and volume/morphology workflow
avoid: Do not add radiotherapy treatment planner
required_test: Dice and physical distance checks against reference

name: PyRadiomics
read_locations: Inspect feature extractor, preprocessing requirements and validation examples
adopt_or_adapt: Use supported package only for justified features
avoid: Do not claim unvalidated radiomics predictive utility

name: Cornerstone3D
read_locations: Inspect packages/tools, viewport, segmentation loaders and examples
adopt_or_adapt: Evaluate direct library integration rather than all of OHIF
avoid: Do not recode entire DICOM viewport layer
required_test: Render known DICOM and overlay matched segmentation

name: VTK
read_locations: Inspect marching cubes, polydata and mesh export examples
avoid: Do not infer anatomical truth from smoothing

name: MONAI Deploy App SDK
avoid: Do not require heavyweight SDK on local laptop

name: BreastMRISegmentator
read_locations: Inspect README, docs, weights release, license and channel requirements
adopt_or_adapt: Adopt only if checkpoint and license actually verified
avoid: Do not block tumor viewer on unavailable weights
required_test: Model download, four-channel inference and anatomy labels

name: SlicerRadiomics
read_locations: Inspect PyRadiomics integration and geometry settings
avoid: Do not install GUI in API runtime
